nodes.label: og-source.html — Open Graph card source
nodes.rationale: Rendered at exactly 1200x630 and screenshotted; never served, and excluded from deploys via .vercelignore.

nodes.label: Keep the card's source so it can be rebuilt
nodes.rationale: Kept in the repo so the card can be regenerated when the figures change, instead of becoming a stale binary nobody can rebuild. The og:image URL is version-stamped so the preview can never drift from the page it advertises.

nodes.label: OG card stat strip (mirrors the live hero strip)
nodes.rationale: Mirrors the live page deliberately — hairline gaps, tabular mono figures, and the same faint grid language rather than decoration for its own sake.

nodes.label: Google Fonts CDN for the card render
nodes.rationale: The card is rendered once offline and screenshotted, so a remote font fetch costs no visitor anything — unlike the served page, which self-hosts and preloads its two critical faces.
